rationale: The last three 1-minute candles have produced lower highs (170.61 → 170.55 → 170.51) and closes on or near the lows while volume on upside breaks has contracted, erasing the net upward drift and fresh high that supported entry. Holding above VWAP is noted but does not offset the clear loss of momentum since the maximum favorable excursion of just 0.04 %.
